patterns.note: Full-bleed, atmospheric photography is used as a background for large typographic statements, creating immersive section introductions.
Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings serve as primary visual anchors and section dividers, often spanning the full viewport width.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and white dominates, punctuated by subtle, earthy accent colors and vibrant product photography.
The hero text 'GO AGAINST THE GRAIN' remains relatively fixed while its background image scrolls at a faster rate, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Sections are introduced by monumental typographic statements that act as visual breaks and content anchors, rather than traditional small headings.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a fixed or slow-scrolling text layer positioned over a faster-scrolling background image to achieve a subtle parallax depth effect.
Major content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.
A horizontal scrolling carousel is used for product categories, allowing users to browse a wide range of options without vertical page bloat.

design_tokens.type_scale: Hero and section headings are dramatically oversized (up to ~8x body text) and bold, creating strong visual hierarchy, while body and label text is clean and legible.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, buttons, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample padding around content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness, though product grids are more compact.

standout: The site's distinctive use of monumental, full-width typography as primary section dividers, combined with atmospheric, full-bleed photography and a high-contrast palette, creates a powerful, editorial, and almost brutalist aesthetic that feels highly curated and premium.
